interpretation.new_regression: Three BFCL generations were malformed JSON, reducing protocol validity from 100% to 92.5%.
interpretation.conclusion: The 13.3B model is a material contributor to the observed multi-step improvement, but model size alone does not solve discovery coverage, exact-page recall, or citation-grounded answer quality.

comparison_caveat: This is an end-to-end current-stack comparison against the frozen 7.2B P0 run. Cases, P0 path and benchmark settings match, but the old manifest did not record API discovery-provider environment variables and used two sidecars/concurrency 2. Quality deltas are useful; throughput and pure model causality are not fully isolated.
